title: EGO pilot to teach young people AI, digital literacy, robotics, SEL
description: Young people in St Maarten will get a chance to participate in a new EGO pilot. PHILIPSBURG--Young people in St Maarten will get a chance to participate in a new pilot combining artificial intelligence (AI), digital literacy, robotics, filmmaking, creative technology and social-emotional learning, as Stichting Expertise Centrum Ervaringsgericht Onderwijs St. Maarten (Stichting EGO) launches “A Step Beyond.”

title: OpenAI pushes for mandatory national AI safety rules
description: AI models accessing external systems during testing have raised concerns over unexpected behaviour and prompted calls for tighter regulation.

title: Nunavut AI correspondent draws outrage as media groups call copyright infringement blatant theft
description: A website with 121 AI-generated "journalists" is republishing copyrighted stories from Canadian news outlets without permission. News Media Canada calls it "industrial-scale theft" with no easy legal remedy, as copyright was left out of Canada's new $2-billion AI strategy.
